name: Safety Choice (Eye-Tracking Study)
description: Rebuilt from the published description of Kang et al. (2026). Participants choose the safer of two Helsingborg street views; the participant ID from the link (?pid=...) and per-trial timestamps allow linking to eye-tracker recordings. Images chosen at least 3 times are labelled safe. Differences from the original study: (1) Eye tracking is not part of the platform; record it separately and join on pid and the trial timestamps. (2) Bundled images are photographs from the paper PDF (8 scenes), not the original full stimulus set.
author: Kang et al.

config.title: Street Safety Choice
config.description: For each pair, choose the place that looks safer.
